reference.shortdesc: A topic head is a title-only entry in a DITA map.

keywords.indexterm: messages issued by processorstopichead with no navigation title

section.title: Usage information
section.p: The topichead element is a convenience element. It is equivalent to a topicref element with the following components:

ul.li: No href, keys, or keyref attributes

section.title: Rendering expectations
section.p: When the navigation title associated with a topichead element is rendered, it appears as a heading in a table of contents. In print contexts, it also appears as a heading in the rendered body content.

section.title: Processing expectations
section.p: Processors SHOULD generate a warning if a navigation title is not specified on a topichead element.

section.title: Specialization hierarchy
section.p: The topichead element is specialized from topicref. It is defined in the mapgroup-domain module.

section.title: Attributes
section.p: The following attributes are available on this element: , , format, scope, and type.
